Jankmajtis Jewish Cemetery Two

Jewish Cemetery · Jánkmajtis, Hungary

Not demolished. There were reportedly two Jewish cemeteries within the modern territory of Jánkmajtis, itself formed in 1950 by the merger of the villages Ják and Matis. This cemetery was in use as early as 1884, with its latest surviving tombstone dated 1933. In 1880, the Jewish populations of Ják and Matis stood at 58 and 15 respectively; on May 31, 1944, the fourth deportation from the Mátészalka Ghetto, documented elsewhere in this collection, carried the Jews of both villages to Auschwitz.
